<div class="card-body">
'''Power Harpoon''' is a [[Light]] [[Weapon]] ([[Vehicle Weapon]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">パワー・ハープーン</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">2フォース消費して任意の戦闘用ビークルかシャトル・ビークルに配備する。1フォース消費して、ＡＴ－ＡＴかＡＴ－ＳＴを目標として起動する。運命数を引く。運命数＋ビークルの回避値＞8なら、目標は“クラッシュ”する。運命数＝0なら自分のビークルが“クラッシュ”する。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Power-Harpoon-PSA-85187826.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">引き込み装置付のケーブルに接続され、融合ディスクの穂先を持った強力な銛。ベリル・シフォナージが対ＡＴ－ＡＴ用の予備兵器として設計した。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Power Harpoon.

'''Card text:'''
Use 2 Force to deploy on any combat vehicle or shuttle vehicle. Use 1 Force to activate targeting an AT-AT or AT-ST. Draw destiny. The target “crashes” if destiny plus the vehicle’s maneuver is greater than 8. Your vehicle “crashes” if destiny equals 0.

'''Lore:'''
A powerful harpoon with a fusion-disk tip, attached to a cable with a retractor. Beryl Chiffonage designed it as a reserve weapon against AT-ATs.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Printed subtype is ビークル用兵器.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Power Harpoon]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
